units.source_text: 名人抹乱了棋盘上的棋子，七段将黑子放进棋盒里。

en.t: The Master swept the stones on the board into disorder, and the seventh-dan player put the black stones into the go bowl.

units.source_text: 对于对手，名人没说一句感想，像平时一样，若无其事地站起来走了。

en.t: As for his opponent, the Master did not say a single word of reflection; just as usual, he stood up as if nothing had happened and left.

units.source_text: 当然，七段也没吐露什么感想。

en.t: Of course, the seventh-dan player did not reveal any thoughts either.

units.source_text: 倘使是七段输了，总该说点什么吧。

en.t: If it had been the seventh-dan player who lost, surely he would have said something.
